title: Quyết định 729/QĐ-BGDĐT ban hành Định dạng đề thi đánh giá năng lực sử dụng tiếng Anh từ bậc 3 đến bậc 5 theo Khung năng lực ngoại ngữ 6 bậc dùng cho Việt Nam
publisher: Bộ Giáo dục và Đào tạo (Ministry of Education and Training, Vietnam)
attributionText: Bộ GD&ĐT, Quyết định số 729/QĐ-BGDĐT ngày 11/3/2015.
contentCovered: Test structure for all four skills; scoring on a 0–10 scale rounded to 0.5; average-to-level conversion table (Bậc 3/4/5).
notes: Read in full from the Hanoi University of Industry mirror. A scanned copy is also on sdh.hcmute.edu.vn. Primary source for the exam specification.

title: VSTEP – Test format
publisher: VSTEP Testing Center, University of Languages and International Studies (ULIS), VNU Hanoi
attributionText: VSTEP Testing Center, ULIS – VNU Hanoi.
contentCovered: Skill-by-skill format; gives the reading total as 1,900–2,500 words (the decree says 1,900–2,050).
notes: Consistent with the decree apart from the reading word range. No per-part listening split or speaking timing.

title: Test Format for the VSTEP Test
publisher: International School, Vietnam National University, Hanoi
contentCovered: English description of the VSTEP format (same as ULIS).

title: Thông tư 23/2017/TT-BGDĐT – Quy chế thi đánh giá năng lực ngoại ngữ theo Khung năng lực ngoại ngữ 6 bậc dùng cho Việt Nam (amended by TT 24/2021/TT-BGDĐT)
publisher: Bộ Giáo dục và Đào tạo
contentCovered: Rules for organising language proficiency examinations (not the test format).
notes: Search summaries report a draft replacement circular; its status could not be confirmed.

title: Đề thi mẫu VSTEP.3-5 (B1, B2, C1) 4 kỹ năng có đáp án chi tiết
publisher: ZIM Academy (Công ty cổ phần Eduvator)
contentCovered: Listening split 8/12/15; speaking part timings 3′/4′/5′; sample tests with explanations.
notes: Secondary source. Its listening split and speaking timings are not in the decree, so they are marked unverified. Terms (zim.vn/dieu-khoan-su-dung) forbid copying without ZIM's written approval. Link only.

title: VSTEP preparation resources (free B1/B2/C1 sample downloads, online practice)
contentCovered: B1/B2/C1 four-skill sets (download via lead form) and an online mock test.
notes: Terms: materials are copyright-protected; copying needs Vivian's prior written approval. Link only; set contents not inspected.

title: ACE of English – VSTEP practice platform
contentCovered: Single-skill VSTEP libraries: 16 Reading mock tests, 13 Listening tests, Writing and Speaking practice with AI feedback.
notes: Terms §6 forbid copying or distributing practice materials without written permission; §7 forbids automated collection. Link only.

title: Đề thi minh họa (Bậc 3 - 5) and Reading answer key
publisher: Trung tâm Ngoại ngữ, Trường Đại học Cần Thơ (CFLA)
licenseType: No licence stated (all rights reserved by default; linked only)
attributionText: Trường Đại học Cần Thơ – CFLA.
contentCovered: Four-skill illustrative VSTEP 3–5 test; answer key published for Reading only.
notes: Partial: no Listening key; audio availability not verified.

title: VSTEP Prep original practice materials
attributionText: Original material written for this platform; simulates the VSTEP.3–5 format but is not an official test.
contentCovered: All seeded passages, listening scripts, questions, prompts, sample responses and rubrics.
